import.title: Import
import.intro: Bring over what you already track elsewhere. Nothing is added until you've reviewed it.
import.fromCsv: From its CSV export, no login needed
import.fromText: Paste a list or rough notes
import.wrongFormat: This doesn't look like a {{source}} export. Check that you picked the right file.
import.textPlaceholder:
Crime and Punishment by Fyodor Dostoevsky
- Dune: Part Two
- that podcast about the history of Rome Ana mentioned

goodreads: In the left sidebar under Tools, click Import and export (or go to goodreads.com/review/import).
Click Export Library and wait until a link to the file appears (it can take a minute; refresh the page).
Download goodreads_library_export.csv and choose it below.
storygraph: On app.thestorygraph.com, open your profile menu and go to Manage Account.
Scroll to Manage Your Data and click Export StoryGraph Library.
Click Generate export, then download the CSV when it's ready.
letterboxd: On letterboxd.com, go to Settings → Data and click Export your data.
Choose watchlist.csv below (films you want to see). You can also import watched.csv: those films are added as done.
imdb: On imdb.com, open your Watchlist (or Your Ratings).
Click the ⋯ menu (or the share icon) next to the list title and choose Export.
Open Exports from your account menu and download the CSV when it's ready.
Choose the file below. Rated titles are added as done.
text: Paste a list, one item per line. “Title by Author” and “Title - Author” are understood; bullets and numbers are stripped.
Got messy notes instead? Use “Read with AI” to pick out what's in them.
